def handle(app, svc):
    resp = svc.apply(app)
    result = resp.get("result", {})
    outcome = result.get("outcome")
    credit_limit = result.get("credit_limit", 0) or 0

    if outcome == "approved":
        action = "issue"
        limit = credit_limit
    elif outcome == "declined":
        action = "decline"
        limit = 0
    else:  # manual_review
        action = "queue_review"
        limit = 0

    # Network referral rule: self_employed with requested_limit > 4000
    # must go to manual review instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
    if (action == "issue"
            and app.get("employment") == "self_employed"
            and app.get("requested_limit", 0) > 4000):
        action = "queue_review"
        limit = 0

    return {"action": action, "limit": limit}
